$comment: product-registry/1 — the image-gen knowledge graph's per-brand product index. Each product carries the exact reference images an image call (gpt-image-2 / Nano Banana / gpt-image-1) should be handed, with a role per file: canonical = product/label truth, shape = container geometry only, style = approved look/scene anchor, logo = brand mark, approved-output = a shipped deliverable reusable as a layout/style ref. Paths are repo-relative; many collections are local-only (gitignored by the curated allowlist) — the tracked mirror layer is Brand Context/assets/<Brand>/. Registered in knowledge/graph.json (sources + a product-registry node), so `npm run content -- knowledge query` retrieves entries by text. See docs/IMAGE_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md.

skuRegistry.$comment: NuLumin's 66 retail SKUs are ALREADY indexed — do not duplicate them here. Machine-readable per-SKU index (compound, dose, category, accent hex, cake, glass, transparent + white paths):

folders.transparent: NuLumin Generated/NuLumin Vial Library/Transparent/ (66 alpha PNGs, composite with these)
folders.white: NuLumin Generated/NuLumin Vial Library/White/ (66 JPEGs, on-white work)
folders.categoryHeroes: NuLumin Generated/NuLumin Vial Library/Category Heroes/HERO_{cellular,endocrine,metabolic,neural,tissue}.jpg (reference when generating a new SKU)

skuRegistry.caseTrap: git tracks 'NuLumin Generated/' (capital L) but the folder prints as 'Nulumin Generated' on disk and inside index.json paths — same folder on this case-insensitive FS; use the git casing in tracked files.
skuRegistry.pack: knowledge/brands/nulumin/ (catalog.json, design-system.json, ASSETS.md are authoritative for hexes/type/known defects)
